pr.title: docs(cockpit): prepare merge stack consolidation
pr.body:
## Summary
- audit Cockpit PR stack 568-571 for consolidation readiness
- produce deterministic stack state, ancestry, readiness, validation, handoff, next-step, checksum, and proof artifacts
- preserve Cockpit governance blockers and avoid all PR/base/branch mutations

## Strict scope
- artifact-only and read-mostly
- no PRs merged
- no branches retargeted
- no rebase
- no force push
- no branch deletion
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no canonical writes
- no runtime reclassification

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See proof artifact for command outputs and exit codes.

## Residual risks and downstream packet
- merge execution requires a later Ledger authorization
- remote-mutation policy should not proceed until the stack is merged or Ledger explicitly accepts building on a stacked branch

steps.task: Verify dedicated worktree identity, GitHub PR metadata, expected audited heads, accepted proof artifacts, repo authority files, and Cockpit stack scope before writing consolidation artifacts.
validation: Worktree root, branch, marker, origin, HEAD, and clean status are verified.
PRs 568-571 are open, non-draft, expected base/head pairs, and expected audited head OIDs.
Accepted proof and inventory artifacts exist and parse.

steps.task: Create deterministic stack state and ancestry reports without merging, rebasing, retargeting, deleting branches, or editing accepted upstream artifacts.
validation: Ancestry checks confirm the declared stack order 568 -> 569 -> 570 -> 571 and this packet branch base.
Report records diff file counts, changed file summaries, proof paths, residual risks, and boundary preservation.

steps.task: Create consolidation readiness, validation, merge handoff, downstream recommendation, checksum, proof, and proof marker artifacts.
validation: Merge handoff states it is not authorization and uses operator-only command candidates that do not self-trigger forbidden command greps.
PROOF.json records no PR/base/branch mutation happened and preserves governance blockers.

steps.task: Add focused artifact tests for merge stack proof invariants and governance preservation.
validation: Tests verify stack order, no merge claim, no final-screen unlock recommendation, no mutation claim, and blocked Claude Design governance.

steps.task: Run required validation commands, inspect diff, run codereview/precommit where available, commit allowed files, push, and open a PR against codex/cockpit-inventory-regen-001 if authenticated.
validation: Required JSON, checksum, compileall, pytest, boundary grep, forbidden mutation grep, and git diff checks pass or exact blocker is recorded.
Only allowlisted files are staged and committed.
PR URL or exact PR creation blocker is recorded in proof and final closeout.
